functionalRequirement: User shall be able to choose payment methods such as PayPal balance, debit or credit card, and transfer funds by entering recipient's email ID or name, and making the payment.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support at least three payment methods (PayPal balance, debit card, credit card) for 100% of payment transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires multiple payment options to ensure users can complete transactions using their preferred method.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately process payments and reflect the correct amount debited or credited for 99.9% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise financial transactions, which must be correct to maintain user trust.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process payment transactions within 2 seconds for 95% of cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick processing of payments is crucial for user satisfaction and retention.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The payment interface must allow users to complete a payment within three clicks or taps, with clear instructions for each payment method.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with payment options, necessitating an intuitive and easy-to-learn interface.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all payment information using AES-256 encryption during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Payment information is sensitive and must be protected to prevent unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that all payment transactions are logged securely and cannot be altered after completion.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Maintaining the integrity of transaction records is essential for accountability and auditing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The payment processing system must be operational 99.9% of the time to ensure users can make transactions at any time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: High availability is critical for a payment system to ensure users can complete transactions without interruption.

functionalRequirement: System shall automatically update the available quantity of each medicine after a sale is completed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must automatically update the available quantity of each medicine for 100% of sales transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires that stock levels be accurately maintained to reflect real-time inventory after sales.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must update the available quantity within 1 second after a sale is completed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Real-time updates are essential to prevent overselling and ensure accurate inventory management.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from failures during the update process without losing transaction data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies that the system must handle errors gracefully to maintain data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy updates to the inventory management logic without requiring extensive downtime.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Flexibility in maintaining and updating the system is important to adapt to changing business needs.
